*THE DOCTOR'S OFFICE — Prologue B "the verdict" (docs/DESIGN.md Story). The front room of the east neighbor cottage in town (the door banners name it — one village, one doctor), rebuilt 2026-07-16 as a small dense diorama on the loft-bedroom recipe. Kitty survives the crash but her memory is gone; the stork doctor delivers the verdict; Basil sits at the bedside and she looks at him like a kind stranger. Then he leaves, and the town's clinic-steps phase closes the chapter. Interior pattern; Kitty is the npc_kitty_bed sprite propped at the pillow, the doctor an npc_stork sprite, both posed by the Theater.*

## `_verdict_cutscene`

**DR. CICONIA**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:76:35`</sub>
> You're Basil. The name engraved on her little glass. Sit, if you like. She's stable.

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:87:29`</sub>
> Kitty. Kitty, I'm here. It's me. I'm so sorry - you told ME to stay put, and then YOU were the one on the road, I -

**DR. CICONIA**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:89:35`</sub>
> Gently. She's been asking who she is. The body will mend - the leg, the ribs. All of it heals.

**DR. CICONIA**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:90:35`</sub>
> But the blow to her head... the memories are gone. We have magic to mend near anything - bone, blood, fever. Memory is the one thing it will not touch.

**DR. CICONIA**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:91:35`</sub>
> And a memory doesn't simply vanish. When it leaves her, it returns to the spirit of the world - it lives on out there, somewhere. Just... not in her.

**DR. CICONIA**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:92:35`</sub>
> Perhaps some part of what you two were will surface again one day, in some far-off place. But she will not be the one to carry it. I am sorry. It is permanent.

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:93:29`</sub>
> Permanent. No. No, she - we've known each other since we were TEN. She taught me everything. She has to -

**KITTY**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:95:29`</sub>
> ...Oh. Hello. You seem very upset. Are you one of my friends? I'm sorry - the nice stork says I've forgotten quite a lot.

**KITTY**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:96:29`</sub>
> You have a kind face. Did we... make something together? I keep thinking about my hands. Isn't that funny.

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:103:29`</sub>
> Your paws. They're folding pleats into the blanket. You always do that when you're think-

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:105:29`</sub>
> ...No. No, we didn't. I'm sorry. I have the wrong room.

**KITTY**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:106:29`</sub>
> Oh. Well - I hope you find who you're looking for. You look like you need to.

**KITTY'S MOTHER**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:121:38`</sub>
> Oh no - Kitty! My baby, what HAPPENED to you?!

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:122:29`</sub>
> It was an accident. She was on the road - she was riding out to see me. It's my fault, I -

**KITTY'S MOTHER**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:129:38`</sub>
> You. YOU did this. She was coming to YOU, and now she doesn't even know her own name.

**KITTY'S MOTHER**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:130:38`</sub>
> Get away from her. I never want you near my daughter again - not now, not ever. Do you understand me?

**BASIL**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:132:29`</sub>
> But - I -

**KITTY'S MOTHER**  <sub>`sickroom.gd:133:38`</sub>
> LEAVE.
